event.text: A new airport for Oslo, Norway, opened at Gardermoen, replacing a smaller one at the same location that had served as a backup to the city's previous main airport at Fornebu.
event.page_extract: Oslo is the capital and largest city of Norway. It constitutes both a county and a municipality. The municipality of Oslo had a population of 724,290 in 2025, while the city's greater urban area had a population of 1,110,887 in 2025, and the metropolitan area had an estimated population of 1,546,706 in 2021.

title: The Terminal at Dusk, MCMXCVIII
artist_statement: I remember the stillness of that first morning, the way light fell across the empty concourse as if waiting for something to begin. There is a particular quality to northern light in winter—clear, cold, and patient. I wanted to capture that moment of potential, the hush before the first footsteps, when a place is still just an idea made of glass and steel.
image_prompt: A vast airport terminal interior at dusk, seen from a low angle. The floor is polished grey stone, reflecting the pale amber glow of ceiling lights. A lone figure stands near a floor-to-ceiling window, looking out at a runway where a single airplane waits under a deep violet sky. The architecture is clean and modernist, with long horizontal lines and a glass curtain wall. Snow begins to fall outside, blurring the distant pine forest. The interior is nearly empty, with a few rows of blue chairs and a departure board glowing softly in the background. The light is subdued, cool, and diffuse, with a single warm lamp over a check-in counter casting a golden pool on the floor. Brushwork is loose and expressive in the shadows, tight and precise on the glass and metal edges.
